reason: Graphlint is primarily a project-analysis plugin that statically parses multi-language codebases, builds dependency graphs, and reports dead code and related warnings through a CLI and Python API.

summaries.zh: Graphlint 通过静态解析多种语言的代码库并构建依赖图，帮助发现死代码及其他代码质量警告。
summaries.en: Graphlint statically analyzes multi-language codebases, builds dependency graphs, and reports dead code and related code-quality warnings.

capabilities: Reads source files to parse code structure and dependencies
Builds and queries a local dependency graph
Reports dead code and other static-analysis warnings
Writes a local analysis index and configuration
Can install or remove agent skill and prompt files when explicitly invoked
